notes: annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2019-12-31 is filed as 2.2525 (40-F/A filed 2020-02-14) and as 1.12625 (40-F filed 2021-02-11) — restated for a share-basis change with no ratio fact filed — the diluted share count for the period ended 2019-06-30 was re-filed ×2.00 on 2020-07-31; read as 2-for-1 (the per-share values move ×2.0000, the share count ×2.0000); 1.12625 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, DividendsPaidOrdinarySharesPerShare)

share-basis change with no ratio fact filed: the FY DPS for the period ended 2019-12-31 and the diluted share count for the period ended 2019-06-30 were both re-filed by the same factor (first on 2020-07-31) — read as a 2-for-1 split effective 2020-07-31; every per-share fact last filed before 2020-07-31 is restated by it

split adjustment (paid DPS): 9 facts for periods ending 2016-12-31..2018-12-31 were last filed before the 2-for-1 split effective 2020-07-31 (no ratio fact: the factor the filer re-filed its FY DPS and diluted share counts by) and are divided by the split ratio (filed, or evidenced by the re-filed values) to today's share basis

share_issuance: quarters left out (not a sign error) — quarter ended 2020-06-30: the year-to-date facts decrease (2020-01-01..2020-03-31 = 1,500,000,000 > 2020-01-01..2020-06-30 = 1,495,000,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -5.0M; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)
quarterly flows: fewer than four consecutive quarterly rows — dividends_paid_ttm / buybacks_ttm / issuance_ttm null

warnings: core facts filed in CAD — figures are shown as filed (no FX conversion here; the engine converts for the valuation)
